notes: Cai dat: tai file HPCONS-BIM-Setup-2.0.18.exe ben duoi, DONG Revit roi chay (can quyen Admin). - Khung cot theo cao do MAI + do doc mai: (a) "Tao khung tu dong" - cot hop, 2 canh bam mat duoi mai, thanh chong; (b) "Theo family trong file mau" - addin tu sinh bien the family "Khung nha xe - 01 H<MAI> D<doc>" (canh xoay theo doc, cot cao theo MAI, giu dang mau). - Family khung doi ten "Khung nha xe - 01" (ten cu KHUNG NHA XE V2 van nhan). Bo tri cot: A (1 hang giua) / B (2 hang, khoang lui tu truc A,C; 0 = tai truc); khoang lui nhap tay duoc giu dung so. Radio "Ngang nha" / "Doc nha"; Ngang nha = khung tai moi truc so, cot tai A/C. - Tuy chon X mai vuon ngoai truc cot; 5 hinh minh hoa thong so...
